long-way:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: original flat graphic for an Out of Office Club t-shirt print. Deliver artwork only, NOT a shirt mockup or photograph.
Primary request: sophisticated vintage national parks travel poster graphic, clean professional screenprint illustration. A winding ivory road leads through angular deep forest green mountain foothills toward layered mountains and a large warm orange setting sun, golden ochre sky.
Style/medium: bold simplified flat color shapes, lightly tactile screenprint ink texture only, precise crisp edges and refined editorial typography.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 aspect ratio, intentional rectangular poster design on uniform warm off-white solid background. Entire graphic and text centered with comfortable margins. Small top brand line, dominant beautiful landscape illustration, bold two or three line slogan below. Unified tasteful apparel design, premium independent outdoor brand.
Color palette: deep forest green #143E2D, golden ochre #DAAF50, burnt orange #D96031, uniform warm off-white #F5F0E4. Restrained four color print.
Text (verbatim): small "OUT OF OFFICE CLUB"; large "TAKE THE LONG WAY".
Constraints: render all lettering correctly, bold highly legible vintage sans serif. No other text. Completely flat artwork viewed straight on, no perspective, no clothing, no shadows or photography, no watermark, no gradients, no transparency. Generate at the largest useful portrait resolution with clean edges for printing.

shirt-base: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: reusable apparel catalog base. Photoreal studio product photograph of a completely blank white unisex classic cotton crewneck t-shirt, Gildan-style standard fit. Full garment laid perfectly flat, straight-on top-down, centered and symmetric, sleeves extended naturally, collar near 15 percent of image height and bottom hem near 88 percent. Entire shirt visible with margins. Square composition. Neutral warm very light grey studio background, soft realistic studio shadows, fine cotton knit texture and minimal natural folds. Smooth flat chest for later artwork placement. No labels, no text, no graphics, no logos, no props, no hangers, no person. Pure white shirt distinct from background. Largest useful square resolution.
